name: Dragged to the Depths

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #7-03: A Foot in the Door

disable: DC 20 Athletics check to pull the tentacles from the mast, stopping the ship from rocking; two total successes are required to disable the hazard.
reset: The squid releases the ship for one round before regripping the mast and resetting the hazard The hazard no longer resets once the PCs defeat the naiads or they flee
routine: (two actions) On its initiative, the squid uses its first action to pull on the mast Every creature must attempt a DC 20 Reflex save save On a failure, it falls Prone If a creature is prone when attempting the save, it slides 10 feet in a direction determined by the GM on a failure If this movement would force a creature off the ship, it can attempt to Grab an Edge The squid uses its second action to make one tentacle attack

items.name: Flip the Ship
items.text:
Trigger The naiads board the ship

---
Effect Each creature standing on the deck must attempt a DC 20 Reflex check save or fall Prone. The hazard then rolls initiative.

text: A giant squid rams the ship from below, using its beak to puncture the hull. It then wraps its tentacles around the mast, rocking the ship violently.
